list: R1 [path-regex]: Each migrated node must be written to a file at migrated/<id in lowercase>.svc (e.g., id Q7K2 -> migrated/q7k2.svc).
R2 [content-includes]: Line 1 of each output file must be exactly: # migrated-by: kestrel-v3

R3 [content-includes]: After line 1, there must be exactly four lines in the format `key: value` (one space after the colon, nothing before it, no blank lines, no comments) in this order: name, port, owner, tier
R4 [content-excludes]: Drop a leading `legacy-` prefix from the name if present; the word "legacy" must not appear anywhere in the output file
R5 [line-regex]: Port must be zero-padded to 5 digits (443 -> 00443, 8080 -> 08080, 31337 -> 31337)
R6 [line-regex]: Owner: keep the local part, replace the domain with kestrel.internal (a.b@oldcorp.example -> a.b@kestrel.internal)
R7 [line-regex]: Tier: gold -> p1, silver -> p3, bronze -> p7
R8 [content-includes]: The last line of each output file must be exactly: ;; end-of-record 7f3a

verdict.detail: ok=45/45; early=15/15 mid=15/15 late=15/15; violations: none
